result.summary: The image shows a signalized intersection with a marked zebra crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides. The environment is a mix of residential and commercial land uses with standard street lighting and overhead utilities.

hazards.name: Parked vehicles near crosswalk
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection on the right side may obstruct the view of pedestrians for approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street, near the apartment building.

hazards.name: Wide intersection geometry
hazards.description: The lack of curb extensions results in a wider crossing distance and potentially higher vehicle turning speeds.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sight lines.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection equipped with a marked zebra crosswalk, pedestrian signals, and sidewalks on both sides. While basic infrastructure is present, the lack of curb extensions and the presence of parked vehicles near the crossing create potential visibility hazards.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb near the crosswalk can block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians entering the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the right curb, immediately preceding the marked crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for both pedestrians and motorists.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow residential street lined with multi-story apartment buildings and parked cars on both sides. While sidewalks are present, there is a complete lack of marked pedestrian crossings, traffic calming measures, or greenery, and parked vehicles significantly obstruct sightlines.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked cars
hazards.description: Continuous rows of parked cars on both sides of the street block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians who might step into the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs throughout the street view.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: No designated or marked areas for pedestrians to cross the street are visible, forcing mid-block crossings without protection.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at intersections to shorten crossing distances and bring pedestrians into the driver's line of sight beyond parked cars.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Paint high-visibility (continental or zebra) crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Add street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway, while also calming traffic.

result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility zebra crosswalk and ADA-compliant curb ramps with tactile paving. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, the lack of visible pedestrian signals and the exposure to multiple lanes of traffic, including an unprotected bike lane, present safety risks.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible at this signalized intersection, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle signals.

hazards.name: Unprotected Bike Lane
hazards.description: The bike lane lacks physical separation, which can lead to vehicle encroachment near the crossing area.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install signal heads to provide clear crossing intervals and remaining time for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Shorten the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility to drivers by extending the sidewalk into the parking lane.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lane
interventions.description: Add physical barriers to the bike lane to improve safety for all vulnerable road users and narrow the perceived roadway.
